rv.q: It’s an inspired alternative holiday offering in a perfect, absolutely pleasurable production.

This five-member cast filled the Citadel Theater with sounds that felt like musical hugs, while the simple yet functional set (designed by Eric Luchen) made of boxes and squares glowed with colorful warmth (lights by Samuel Stephen ).
I was very impressed and recommend ‘You’re a Good Man, Charlie Brown’ for a pleasant night of family entertainment that will have you leaving with a big smile.
Citadel Theatre's cast does, instilling warmth in the hearts of old and young audiences members alike, sending them from the theater with smiles on their faces and a spring in their step.
This is a great family show and runs two hours with a 13 minute intermission.
Kudos to Sally and Schroeder whose tap dance knocks it out of the park.

cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this family-friendly production, praising its timeless appeal and ability to delight both children and adults with the beloved Peanuts gang's exploration of everyday joys and what it means to be a good person.
